variants.headline: Still in view: bid to remove government fails
variants.sub: The attempt to remove the government by an Assembly vote has failed.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. A vote to bring down the government has failed in {colony}.

We find the conduct of {target} wanting. Whatever the result of this attempt, parliamentary manoeuvre is no substitute for political responsibility or an adequate account of the public interest.

variants.headline: Still in view: confidence challenge falls short
variants.sub: The government has survived a vote intended to bring it down.
variants.body:
This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event. The attempt to remove the government by an Assembly vote has failed.

We find the conduct of {target} wanting. Whatever the result of this attempt, parliamentary manoeuvre is no substitute for political responsibility or an adequate account of the public interest.

variants.headline: Still in view: government survives the Assembly test
variants.sub: A vote to bring down the government has failed in {colony}.
variants.body:
Our attention to this story continues after {months_running} months, with the original report still the starting point. The government has survived a vote intended to bring it down.

We find the conduct of {target} wanting. Whatever the result of this attempt, parliamentary manoeuvre is no substitute for political responsibility or an adequate account of the public interest.
